name: Gobo
desc: A cookie in front of the key — the whole frame is broken into shaped light and shadow by a drifting gobo: dappled leaf breakup shivering in the wind, hard venetian slats, a keystoned window, or a rotating abstract aperture, with warm beam and complementary sky-blue shadow and a focus knob from crisp cut to thrown right out.

energy.doc: how hard the light is shaped — shadow depth and beam lift

scale.doc: gobo size — how large the pattern is thrown

density.doc: pattern frequency: a few broad shapes or fine busy breakup

soft.doc: focus — 0 is a crisp cut cookie, 1 is thrown right out of focus

hue.doc: beam colour temperature (42 = warm sun); shadows take the complement, the way sky fill really works

x.doc: gobo offset x — pans the pattern across the frame

alpha.doc: master opacity of the whole pass

style.doc: which cookie is in the gate
